bridge_aerial.scale_bar: 10 m bar approximately 118 px; widths depend on exact edge and orthophoto/parallax.
bridge_aerial.method: Bridge road spans roughly85–95pixels perpendicular to centreline; parapet-to-parapet envelope roughly120–140pixels. Compared with Street View narrow slab footways.

measurement_inputs.heights: No measured elevation values. Inherited north control 0.7845 m, provisional bridge crest 5.1 m and roundabout 3.1 m. Profiles encode visible rise/descent and estimated clearance; uncertainty up to 1.5 m.
measurement_inputs.footprints: Projected OSM geographic coordinates using memorial tangent frame; visible Google 3D roof/front setbacks checked collectively. Parallax, eaves and missing rear views leave1–2m uncertainty; no claim of surveyed individual footprints.

comparison: First assembled review showed excessive bridge width and incomplete roundabout exit stubs. Revised widths from close aerial and included all connected roundabout arms. Placeholder roofs intentionally remain flat height envelopes.
missing: Detailed facade/roof geometry, measured ground control, parapet mosaic design, street lamp placements, private rear access details.
